runbooks.title: Raise checkout-api connection pool and add a ledger circuit breaker
steps: Raise DB_POOL_SIZE on checkout-api from 20 to 60 and roll the deployment.
Enable the ledger circuit breaker so pool waiters fail fast instead of queueing.
Confirm pool wait time is under 5ms for 10 minutes.

runbooks.title: Rotate the internal TLS certificate and reload auth-service
steps: Issue the replacement internal certificate from the platform CA.
Roll auth-service with the new secret; do not restart the edge first.
Verify handshake error rate returns to zero and add a 21-day expiry alert.

runbooks.title: Scale the payments-ledger consumer group and replay the affected partition
steps: Scale the payments-ledger consumer group from 4 to 12 members.
Confirm lag is draining at a sustained rate, not just bouncing.
Replay the affected partition range for the incident window.
Verify ledger reconciliation reports zero unmatched entries.

runbooks.title: Restore the previous fraud model and warm the inference cache
steps: Roll fraud-scorer back to the previous promoted model.
Warm the inference cache with the last 24h of feature vectors.
Confirm p99 is back under the 250ms budget before re-promoting anything.

runbooks.title: Pin the Redis primary and widen the sentinel failover window
steps: Pin redis-cache to the healthy primary and stop the flapping sentinel.
Raise down-after-milliseconds so a slow replica is not promoted prematurely.
Drain stale client connections and confirm hit rate recovers.

runbooks.title: Enable jittered TTLs and single-flight cache fill
steps: Apply TTL jitter so hot keys do not expire together.
Enable single-flight so only one request rebuilds a missing key.
Confirm payments-ledger query rate returns to baseline.

runbooks.title: Roll payments-ledger back to v1.8.2 and move the ledger write off the request path
steps: Roll payments-ledger back to v1.8.2 to stop the bleeding.
Move the audit write to an async publisher before re-attempting the release.
Verify checkout p99 is under 800ms for 15 minutes.

runbooks.title: Cap webhook retry concurrency and add exponential backoff
steps: Cap webhook-dispatcher retry concurrency at 50.
Enable exponential backoff with jitter on delivery retries.
Drain the retry queue and confirm ledger latency is unaffected.

runbooks.title: Restore the previous signing key alongside the new key for an overlap window
steps: Reinstate the previous signing key alongside the new key.
Drain the delivery queue; failures queued before the rotation should clear.
Retire the previous key after a 24h overlap window, once the queue is empty.
Add a rotation checklist that requires a dual-key overlap window.
